skills.description: One verdict for every skill listed in the requirements, each exactly once.

skill.description: The skill name exactly as listed in the requirements.

matched.description: True only if the CV text shows this skill.

evidence.description: A short exact quote from the CV (at most 200 characters) that shows the skill, or null when not matched.

summary.description: Two or three neutral sentences in English about how well the CV fits the posting.
